rulings_i_made: ESO ADMITTED, BOUNDED. context/ESO-argonian_character__* is admitted as construction-quality reference on the FIDELITY side only (RI-VIS08 §B), and stays barred as an ART_DIRECTION target. On the design side it is a divergence anchor. WHY: the owner named ESO as the quality standard, and RI-VIS05 forbids the world converging on ESO's Murkmire — both hold at once if quality and design are separated, which is exactly what the RI-VIS08/RI-VIS10 seam already does. REVERSIBLE: if a critic shows our Saxhleel failing RI-VIS10 B1 race legibility AND that ESO's plates solve the same problem in a way our lore permits, promote it to a design reference and record the verdict that bought it.
